description:
Are there really three heavens? Do fallen angels have varying degrees of wickedness, some less, some more? Find out the answer to these questions, and many more, on 3ABN Today Bible Q & A with Greg Morikone, James Rafferty, Daniel Perrin, and John Lomacang.

Send us your Bible Questions! 
By email: BibleQA@3abn.org 
By text: (618) 228-3975

QUESTIONS COVERED:

1.  Please interpret Luke 20:34-38. 

2.  I've recently been diagnosed with an auto-immune disease and while it's been a struggle to come to terms with my condition and disability, I have been reassured by 2 Corinthians 12:7-10. I've recently felt a pull from The Spirit to use the thorn in my flesh to exalt God, but being introverted, I can't imagine myself doing evangelistic work. I feel God urging me to use my condition to reach people in a similar position as me to serve in spreading His Gospel but I don't know what to do. Can I have some advice? 

3.  Please explain the story in Judges 19:28-30 and about Lots offering his daughter to the men of Sodom. It seems they had little or no regard for their daughters. How could they be considered righteous in God’s eyes? 

4. Could you please explain Hosea chapter 1 verse 2? Did God actually ask Hosea to marry a prostitute? 

5. Are there 3 heavens? I'm a year and a half into being Adventist and wanted to know if that's true. 

6. What scripture references do you use to support the teachings on "investigative judgment"? 

7. Recently I have heard people saying that Jesus was created by the Father and that is why He is called begotten. They also say that He isn't God but just the Son of God. This doesn't make sense to me, what do I say to them? 

8. Do the fallen angels have varying degrees of wickedness, some less and some more? In Luke 11:26, seven other spirits were more wicked than the original one. 

9.  In Rev. 9:4, John explained that the Locust were not to harm the grass of the earth or any green thing or any tree, but only those men who do not have the seal of God on their foreheads. What kind of seal or mark will men of God have on their forehead? Will it be like a Tattoo? 

10. Where do I find the story of Baalam, the prophet, and the donkey that spoke to him? 

11. When you read Matthew 6:9-13, it says do not put us in temptation. I have been asking myself, is it correct or not? Because when you go back to Paul, 1 Corinthians 10:13 says, temptation is normal for human beings. And to Jacob, James 1:2-12, says it's happiness. So what is Matthew saying?

12.  If according to history, and according to Adventist teachings, Daniel 7:25 has already fulfilled, why should we expect another BIG time of Trouble as if All the Incredible SUFFERINGS of the DARK AGES were not enough? 

 

TDYQA220024
